## Deviations from design (2 found, both by running the FULL suite)

1. **verdict.test.mjs's pre-existing test at (then-)line 174** ("pre-existing
   or base-only findings do NOT trigger REVISE and are routed to
   follow_ups[]") was NOT in the design's audit list (which named only
   `:923` as needing `conclusionCauses: ['blocker']`). It is the SAME
   #483-shape fixture and needed the SAME fix. Caught by running the full
   suite after the GREEN commit, not by the design's own line-numbered
   census. Fixed in the GREEN commit (55b8943), same pattern as `:923`.
2. **My OWN "inherited-only" checkpoint.test.mjs pin was weak**: it used a
   rollup with a failing required gate, whose blocker finding is ALSO
   visible to checkpoint's own `anyBlocker` (checkpoint spreads tranche's
   findings into its own). So "drop the checkpoint union" mutation killed
   ZERO tests on first pass. Fixed by using tranche's rollup-uncomputable
   path instead (`requiredGates: null` → `conclusionCauses: ['uncomputable']`,
   zero findings — genuinely invisible to checkpoint's own checks). Landed as
   its own commit 33d01f8 (test-quality fix, not part of the original GREEN).

Both deviations are recorded in Engram (`mem_search` for "verdict.test.mjs:174"
and "mutation census found my own weak pin").
